messages:
Emma_S: FYI customer ACME reported a sudden jump in p95 for /v1/embeddings in eu-west after last night's infra rollout. p95 went from ~130ms -> ~4.5s, p99 ~12s. Ticket: https://acme.support/RED-2312 :eyes:
Kai: ACK. Can you paste the customer job id + a short repro?
Emma_S: job_id=acme-eu-1138. Repro steps in the ticket but essentially small-batch embeddings (n=4) hitting dedicated pool. I grabbed spans: https://logs.redwood/trace/1912345678-acme
Priya: Any recent driver/firmware changes applied to eu-west last night?
Luis: We pushed CUDA 12.3.1 + nvme microcode 2026-02 on a subset (canary 10% -> ramp). Deploy-bot shows rollout started 2026-02-18 23:40 UTC.
deploy-bot: rollout start confirmed for tag infra/drivers/2026-02-18. Canary hosts: eu-west-3-[12..21]
Raj_Oncall: Monitoring-bot, show node IO saturation and GPU busy % for the timeframe 23:30-01:30 UTC.
monitoring-bot: top anomalies: nvme_avg_qdepth +120% on eu-west-3-15 & 16; host CPU steal +15%; KV cache miss rate +32% correlated with period 23:50-00:30 UTC.
Kai: NVMe qdepth spike + KV cache miss -> sounds like storage interference causing high host IO latency which then stalls model kernels. Can we get iostat & dmesg from eu-west-3-15? Priya, can you SSH and fetch?
Priya: grabbing now. iostat shows avg await rose from 0.8ms -> 25ms during spike. dmesg contains repeated nvme timeout msgs: "nvme 0000:3b:00.0: I/O 0 QID 3 timeout" around 23:51.
Luis: That matches some kernel-driver incompatibility with the new nvme microcode + our host kernel. Also saw increased GPU kernel preemption events in the telemetry traces.
Emma_S: Customer is seeing retries in their app, they want mitigation ASAP. They said their SLA alerts triggered and revenue flow is impacted. Alice_CS is on the call.
Alice_CS: I've told ACME we are escalating to infra and will share rollback ETA. They asked if we can route traffic to dedicated fallback in another region.
Raj_Oncall: Short-term mitigation options: 1) Pin ACME to eu-west-2 fallback cluster (manual routing) 2) Cordon noisy hosts eu-west-3-15/16 3) Roll back driver/firmware to previous stable. Which is fastest?
Kai: Cordon hosts now and drain workloads -> immediate relief for affected jobs. Rolling back driver requires full node recycle and longer. Routing to another region depends on customer data residency.
Priya: I can cordon + drain those two hosts in 5-10m. Command: `kubectl cordon node/eu-west-3-15 && kubectl drain node/eu-west-3-15 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
Luis: Also enable a temporary routing policy to prefer eu-west-2 for ACME: update customer route `customers/acme/route_preference = [eu-west-2, eu-west-3]` — takes effect instantly.
Emma_S: Doing both: Priya cordon -> I'll update route. Alice, tell customer we expect reduction in p95 within the next 15-20m.
Alice_CS: On it. ACME wants logs of actions for audit. Please append runbook entries.
Priya: cordon done for eu-west-3-15 & 16. Draining pods now. Pod reschedule progress: 6/6 completed.
monitoring-bot: p95 for /v1/embeddings (acme-eu-1138) reduced from 4.5s -> 180ms within 12 minutes of cordon. KV cache hit rate recovering.
Kai: Good signal. Next: bisect whether issue is nvme microcode vs CUDA driver. We should repro on a staging host with same stack. Luis, can you reproduce with a fixed workload?
Luis: Running a replay of ACME's request trace on staging host staging-io-09 with CUDA 12.3.1 + nvme 2026-02: `./replay --trace acme-eu-1138 --concurrency 4 --profile`
Luis: Repro shows p95 spike when background fio runs at high qdepth. With drivers rolled back to CUDA 12.2 + nvme previous microcode, p95 stays ~120ms.
Priya: So microcode + kernel scheduling interaction likely causing host IO timeouts -> kswapd/preempt anomalies. Filing infra bug: INFRA-9793.
Kai: Action items: Priya -> coordinate rollback plan for full eu-west canary (owner: Priya). Luis -> produce a minimal repro script and attach metrics (owner: Luis). Raj -> keep customer informed and confirm SLA adjustments (owner: Raj_Oncall). Emma_S/Alice_CS -> share mitigation notes with ACME and attach runbook (owner: Emma_S).
Priya: Plan: pause rollout, roll back microcode on canary hosts tonight at 02:00 UTC, monitor for 2 hours, then decide full rollback. If safe, roll forward with kernel patches.
Emma_S: ACME acknowledged, wants a postmortem and timeline for preventative measures (driver gating, better pre-rollout stress test).
monitoring-bot: Alert cleared for ACME p95 after host cordon.
deploy-bot: rollback job scheduled: infra/firmware/rollback-2026-02 -> target eu-west-3-[12..21], start 2026-02-19 02:00 UTC.
Kai: After immediate rollback/patch, we should add a short smoke test for storage qdepth + kvcache hit-rate to our preflight pipeline. Luis, can you add a 5-min fio + small embedding run to infra preflight?
Luis: Will add PR with job + threshold checks today.
Alice_CS: Thanks team. ACME asked for a follow-up call tomorrow 09:00 CET. I'll schedule and include Priya & Kai. :thumbsup:
Emma_S: Closing on this thread for now, updating ticket RED-2312 with actions and INFRA-9793 link.
Kai: Major takeaway: controller -> storage microcode interactions can surface as p95/p99 for customers; need tighter mem/IO preflight and rollout throttles.
Raj_Oncall: Keeping monitor until rollback completes. Ping me if anything regresses.
Emma_S: Thanks everyone.
